units: Snh. IX, 6 המקלל בקוֹסֵם (Y. ed. בקַסָּם) he that curses (his neighbor) invoking God as ‘a carver’ (instead of creator ex nihilo); expl. ib. 81ᵇ יכה קוֹסֵם את קוֹסָמוֹ (Ms. M. את קוסו, emended קוסמו, Ar. קִסְמוֹ, קִיסְמוֹ) may the carver strike his carving; anoth. explan. יכהו קוסם לו ולקונו ולמקנו may the carver strike him (euphem. for thee), himself (thyself) &c., v. קָנָה; Y. ib. IX, end, 27ᵇ, v. קַיְינָא.
Ḥag. 14ᵃ (ref. to Is. III, 2) קוסם זה מלך ḳosem means king (with ref. to Prov. XVI, 10); Yalk. Is. 261.
Sifré Deut. 171 איזהו קוסם זה האוחז וכ׳ who is a ḳosem? He that seizes his staff (and measuring it fist-wise says), shall I or shall I not go? (ref. to Hos. IV, 12); Yalk. Deut. 918.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 106a:17">Snh. 106ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Joshua 13:22">Josh. XIII, 22</cite>) <he>קזסם נביא הוא</he> a charmer? is he not a prophet? <he>בתחלה נביא ולבסוף קוסם</he> at first a prophet, and in the end a charmer.

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 20:20">Num. R. s. 20</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Numbers 22:7">Num. XXII, 7</cite>) <he>הוליכו … קסמים שהיו קוֹסְמִין בהן</he> they carried with them all kinds of divining implements with which people divine.
<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 12:7:1">Koh. R. to XII, 7</cite> <he>לִקְסוֹם קסמים</he>, v. <cite ref="S01667"><he>קֶסֶם</he></cite>; a. e.
<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 79:1">Midr. Till. to Ps. LXXIX</cite>, beg. <he>עמד לו מְקַסֵּם וכ׳</he> he stood up and divined to find out whether or not to go up.
